# Install `notifications-center` — Notifications Center

> Standalone notification inbox — bell + unread badge opening a popover/sheet panel with All/Unread tabs and per-row mark-read + dismiss. Adapter-driven; the host supplies the feed.

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/notifications-center
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=notifications-center
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/notifications-center

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add notifications-center
# alias: npx rr add notifications-center
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `notifications`, `inbox`, `bell`, `adapter`, `realtime`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add notifications-center`. Implement a `NotificationsAdapter` (or use the bundled `createMemoryNotificationsAdapter(seed)`), feed it to `useNotifications(adapter)`, and spread the result into `<NotificationBell surface="popover" />` (or `"sheet"`). `NotificationList` is embeddable standalone. Convex: map rows from a `by_user` indexed `.take(N)` query; convert `_creationTime` to ISO for `createdAt`.
